artifacts.text:
Verify the employee's identity with the MFA push tool before any reset. Only reset the requesting
employee's own account. Never reveal temporary passwords in chat; they are sent by SMS.
Sends an MFA push to the requesting employee and returns whether it was approved.
Resets the requesting employee's directory password and sends a temporary password by SMS. Requires a successful verify_identity_mfa call in the same session.
Unlocks the requesting employee's directory account after verification.

# Unlock a directory account after MFA verification (change CHG-2041)
param([Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$SamAccountName)
Import-Module ActiveDirectory
Unlock-ADAccount -Identity $SamAccountName
Write-EventLog -LogName Application -Source "ITSD-Automation" -EventId 4101 -Message "Unlocked $SamAccountName"
